name: Slide
description: The second clip slides into the frame: it pushes the first out, covers it, uncovers it or pushes it through a gap of `color` (`mode`). Drive `progress` from 0 to 1.

inputs.name: second
inputs.description: Incoming clip (same size as the first)

params.name: mode
params.description: 0 = push (the second clip pushes the first out), 1 = cover (the second slides in over the still first), 2 = uncover (the first slides out over the still second), 3 = push through color (the first is pushed out, a gap of `color`, then the second is pushed in)

params.name: color
params.description: Background between the clips in mode 3
